verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents an extensive Core API covering cards, users, businesses, card products, card state transitions, velocity and authorization controls, transactions, disputes, and webhooks. It also offers a public sandbox with simulation endpoints, a quick-start tutorial, and interactive in-browser widgets, so the product can clearly be driven programmatically. Missing for 10: probes found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec at the standard paths (404), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the API in use.
